result.rationale: The diff confirms the mechanism: embed/loading.html.erb reloads unconditionally via setTimeout every 30000ms; EmbedController#best re-enqueues RetrieveTopic when no topic_id exists; and TopicRetriever#fetch_http silently returns when embed_by_username is unset (default '' in site_settings.yml) or names a missing user, so the job 'succeeds' while doing nothing and the visitor loops forever with no error state. This is a real degradation in behavior introduced by the new code.

judged_text: The embed flow has no failure state: EmbedController#best fire-and-forgets the RetrieveTopic job and renders 'loading', and this view reloads unconditionally every 30 seconds, so a permanently failed retrieval (unreachable article, Readability failure, or fetch_http's silent return when embed_by_username is unset or names a missing user — which is the default config, since site_settings.yml ships embed_by_username: '') leaves the visitor in an infinite 'Loading Discussion...' loop with no error ever surfaced. A blog reader on any article whose retrieval failed sees a perpetual loading spinner in the comments area; in the unset-username case the job even completes 'successfully' while doing nothing, so neither the visitor nor the operator gets any signal — the 30s reload just re-enqueues a throttled no-op job on every cycle.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: EmbedController#best enqueues Jobs::RetrieveTopic when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) is nil, then renders `loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The loading view unconditionally reloads every 30s (app/views/embed/loading.html.erb), causing an endless loop if retrieval never produces a TopicEmbed. Retrieval can permanently no-op: TopicRetriever#fetch_http returns if the configured user is missing (lib/topic_retriever.rb: `user = User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first; return if user.blank?`), and the default setting ships as empty string (config/site_settings.yml: `embed_by_username: ''`). There is no error view/state surfaced, so visitors can be stuck in perpetual "Loading Discussion..." with repeated re-enqueue attempts (throttled to 60s by redis, but still no terminal state).
